name: Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude
detailed_description:
Stories from the troubled pasts of two young adults, Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude will take you through their darkest days and immerse you in their deepest emotions.

Alex's Hope
The difficult story of a boy with a bleak future and a critical lack of love finding a reason to regain hope. A dark atmosphere, a cold journey, and a soft warmth will change his fate.

Alex's Solitude
The story of a stubbornly good-hearted girl finding rejection and struggling to fit in. A change in persona, a new friend, and a serious wake-up call will lead her to make a life-changing resolution.

Content Warning
This visual novel contains themes that may be distressing to many individuals, including:

  • Depression
  • Anxiety
  • Suicidal Thoughts
  • Self Harm
  • Substance Abuse
  • Drug Overdose

It does not contain any written or visual depictions of death or any graphic depictions of injury or self harm.

Features

  • Two individual short stories (Combined length of about 7,400 words)
  • Immersive and intensely emotional storytelling
  • Original hand-drawn characters and backgrounds
  • Original, immersive, and very emotionally driven soundtrack with 12 unique songs
  • Three CGs in each story
  • A cute cat
